learning_outcomes.text: The course provides the basis for the development of advanced systems for the analysis and interpretation of biological data. Such systems are used in all areas of information bioengineering in order to build systems to support diagnosis, data interpretation systems in a clinical study and clinical indicators.
Introduce the student to the adoption of the most common computational methods and tools currently exploited in bioinformatics analysis and to the acquisition of notions on their functioning.

The student will have acquired the skills necessary to analyze and interpret biological data through the Python programming language, as well as having notions on the analysis and design of biological databases.
Acquire the basic notions on: algorithms for the analysis of biological data and their applications; interpretation of biological data; analysis and design of biological databases.
The student will know the theoretical and practical aspects of the principles relating to the processing of biological data, as well as notions relating to the analysis of biological databases.
The student will be able to design solutions to simple biological data processing problems.
The student will be able to analyze problems and will be aware of their own abilities, being able to solve a problem even in a different way from how the student learned in class.
The student will be able to describe, with a sufficient level of formalism and appropriate language, a solution to a specific problem.

Given a problem, the student will be able to evaluate the different solution strategies and choose the most suitable in specific circumstances, aware of the limitations and strengths of the strategy adopted.

syllabus_topics: Analysis of Biological Data Using the Python Programming Language
Algorithms for the Analysis of Biological Data
teaching_methods: Practical exercises using Python programming language
assessment_rules: The exam consists of an oral test and a discussion about a project. The oral test consists in the discussion about the topics covered in class in order to evaluate both the student's communication skills and his / her learning ability. The final grade is based on Voto Finale.
bibliography: Mitchell L Model., Bioinformatics Programming Using Python, O'Reilly Media, Inc.
Emanuele Biondi, Claudio Cobelli, “Storia della Bioingegneria”, Patron Editore
degree: Laurea in Ingegneria Medica classe L-9 R Ingegneria industriale
